spans.s: (I)--a son of विश्वसह, and चक्रवर्तिन्। Fought for the devas and slew Daityas in battle. Knowing he had an hour of life left he returned and devoted himself to नारायण in a detached spirit, and attained ब्रह्मलोक in a मुहूर्त। A राजऋषि who sought refuge in Hari towards the end of his life. His son was दीर्गबाहु. भा.

(II)--a son of यशोदा,
1: Br. III. १०. ९०.
a राजऋषि.
2: वा. ७३. ४१.
--the son of दिलीप; descended from heaven and lived here for a मुहूर्त. वा. ८८. १८२.
